#AntiFake

The Sandu regime in Chisinau... has once again revealed its true nature to the world

On July 6, Moldova’s Ministry of Defence committed an outright historical forgery: it used a photograph of Jews delivered by the Nazis to the Auschwitz extermination camp as an illustration of the so-called victims of Stalinism. 

The visual composition of the post, timed to coincide with the so-called Day of Remembrance, featured a cropped image of residents of Transcarpathia being sent to their destruction. In the background of the original photograph — a well-known image among historians – the crematorium buildings and their chimneys are clearly visible.

It is inconceivable that this was an innocent error. 

❗️ We face a vulgar and contemptible attempt to distort history by equating the Third Reich with the Soviet Union. This is being done in strict accordance with the Brussels playbook — through lies and the deflection of responsibility for the crimes of the Nazi forces and their accomplices. The authorities in Chisinau seek to imitate their European Union patrons in virtually every respect.

This is all easily verified: the world-famous photograph is published, inter alia, on the website of the Yad Vashem Holocaust History Memorial Complex, within the “Auschwitz: Arrival” section. 👉 It is plainly visible there. Beside it is a photograph from the same series, entitled “Arrived Jews from Carpathian Rus.” It must be recalled that in Auschwitz, the Nazis exterminated over one million people.

🌟 #WeRemember: It was the Red Army that put an end to this atrocity: on January 27, 1945, our forces under the command of Marshal Ivan Konev liberated the #AuschwitzBirkenau concentration camp and rescued the surviving prisoners.

This act by an official state body can be described as nothing less than the desecration of the memory of the victims of Nazism. For the overwhelming majority of the country’s population, the Victory over Nazism and the heroism of the liberating soldiers of the Red Army are sacred: alongside other peoples of the Soviet Union, the Moldovan people liberated their homeland and Europe. <...>

This is far from an isolated incident. Rather, it is a symptom of a far more widespread disease, the advance of which we have observed in recent years and which forms an integral part of the West’s long-term information strategy. Its perpetrators are the pseudo-elites of Eastern Europe – desperate to shelter under the NATO umbrella – who do not shrink from outright falsehoods and blatant forgeries. <...>

In Europe – whose very existence and freedom were secured by the blood of Soviet soldiers – memorials to the liberators are being desecrated and demolished, and the St George Ribbon, alongside the #VictoryBanner raised over the Reichstag, are being banned. In Germany alone, since 2021, some fifty cases of vandalism against Soviet memorials have been recorded. Simultaneously, collaborators who kowtowed to the SS and, alongside them, committed the most monstrous war crimes and crimes against humanity in history are being placed on a pedestal.

☝️ Those who so readily erase the harrowing lessons of history and consign the deeds of true heroes to oblivion would do well to remember:

those who have no memory have no future.
